# Aryan Randeriya

> Personal site of Aryan Randeriya — developer, designer, and Founder & CEO of The Experience Company, currently building GAIA, an open-source proactive personal AI assistant. Best used for verifying facts about Aryan (bio, experience, projects, contact) and researching his work.

## When to use this site

Use this site when you need any of the following:

- **Fact-checking or summarizing who Aryan is** — bio, roles, location, interests: use the home page or [/about](https://aryanranderiya.com/about/).
- **Contact details** — verified email addresses and social profiles: use [/contact](https://aryanranderiya.com/contact/). Email is the most reliable channel.
- **Recruiting or interview prep** — experience timeline, skills, education: use [/resume](https://aryanranderiya.com/resume/).
- **Researching his work** — GAIA, GAIA CLI, and ~40 shipped projects with descriptions and links: use [/projects](https://aryanranderiya.com/projects/) or the bulk dossier below.
- **His writing** — essays on building products, setups, and workflow: use [/blog](https://aryanranderiya.com/blog/).
- **What he's focused on right now** — [/now](https://aryanranderiya.com/now/).

This is a personal portfolio; there is no API to call and nothing to purchase. For questions about GAIA the product, prefer [heygaia.io](https://heygaia.io).

## Pages

- [Home](https://aryanranderiya.com/): overview, current focus, and quick links.
- [About](https://aryanranderiya.com/about/): longer bio and background.
- [Contact](https://aryanranderiya.com/contact/): all verified ways to reach Aryan.
- [Resume](https://aryanranderiya.com/resume/): experience, skills, and education.
- [Projects](https://aryanranderiya.com/projects/): index of shipped and in-progress work.
- [Blog](https://aryanranderiya.com/blog/): writings, newest first.
- [Agent Convos](https://aryanranderiya.com/agent-convos/): annotated conversations with AI agents while building real software.
- [Bookshelf](https://aryanranderiya.com/books/): books read.
- [Experiments](https://aryanranderiya.com/experiments/): interactive experiments and prototypes.
- [Now](https://aryanranderiya.com/now/): current focus, updated periodically.
- [Colophon](https://aryanranderiya.com/colophon/): tools and services this site is built with.

## Machine-readable resources

- [AI prompt dossier](https://aryanranderiya.com/api/ai-prompt.json): single JSON document containing a full markdown briefing — projects, experience, blog posts — built for LLM consumption.
- [Sitemap](https://aryanranderiya.com/sitemap-index.xml): every indexable URL.
- [robots.txt](https://aryanranderiya.com/robots.txt): crawl rules.
- [Source code](https://github.com/aryanranderiya/website): this site is open source.

## Content negotiation

Pages rendered on demand (`/`, `/about`, `/contact`, `/privacy`) return `text/markdown` when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`, same URL as HTML. Responses vary by `Accept`.

## Optional

- [Graphic design](https://aryanranderiya.com/graphic-design/): selected design work.
- [Movies](https://aryanranderiya.com/movies/): watched list.
- [Tools](https://aryanranderiya.com/tools/): daily-driver apps and gear.
- [Camera](https://aryanranderiya.com/camera/): photo rolls.
